cssci.useNodeFS.description: Use the fs module to read files whenever possible.
cssci.languages.vue.description: Enable the language function for VUE. (the official VUE plugin has implemented CSS intellisense, disable the function if there is a conflict)
cssci.globalCSSFiles.description: Specify a list of css/scss/less files to be used for global import.
cssci.include.description: Specify a list of glob patterns that match files to be included in the global reference.
cssci.exclude.description: Specify a list of glob patterns that match files to be excluded in the global reference.
